required_run.build-test:
status=0
tools/verify.sh --shard=build-test "--base=$POLICY_BASE" --base-source=ci-event || status=$?
artifact_status=0
tools/ci/receipt_artifact.sh >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || artifact_status=$?
if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then
  exit "$status"
fi
exit "$artifact_status"
required_run.e2e:
status=0
tools/verify.sh --shard=e2e "--base=$POLICY_BASE" --base-source=ci-event || status=$?
artifact_status=0
tools/ci/receipt_artifact.sh >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || artifact_status=$?
if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then
  exit "$status"
fi
if [ "$artifact_status" != 0 ]; then
  exit "$artifact_status"
fi
artifact_path="$(sed -n 's/^artifact_path=//p' "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" | tail -1)"
test -n "$artifact_path"
BFF_IMAGE_RUNTIME_OUTPUTS="$artifact_path/image-runtime" tools/checks/image_runtime.sh
BFF_VIDEO_EVIDENCE_OUTPUTS="$artifact_path/web-video-evidence" tools/checks/web_video_evidence.sh
required_run.policy:
status=0
tools/verify.sh --shard=policy "--base=$POLICY_BASE" --base-source=ci-event || status=$?
artifact_status=0
tools/ci/receipt_artifact.sh >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || artifact_status=$?
if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then
  exit "$status"
fi
exit "$artifact_status"

status=0
tools/verify.sh --shard=build-test "--base=$POLICY_BASE" --base-source=ci-event || status=$?
artifact_status=0
tools/ci/receipt_artifact.sh >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || artifact_status=$?
if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then

status=0

artifact_status=0

if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then

fi
if [ "$artifact_status" != 0 ]; then

fi
artifact_path="$(sed -n 's/^artifact_path=//p' "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" | tail -1)"
test -n "$artifact_path"
BFF_IMAGE_RUNTIME_OUTPUTS="$artifact_path/image-runtime" tools/checks/image_runtime.sh
BFF_VIDEO_EVIDENCE_OUTPUTS="$artifact_path/web-video-evidence" tools/checks/web_video_evidence.sh

status=0
tools/verify.sh --shard=policy "--base=$POLICY_BASE" --base-source=ci-event || status=$?
artifact_status=0
tools/ci/receipt_artifact.sh >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT" || artifact_status=$?
if [ "$status" != 0 ]; then
  exit "$status"
fi
exit "$artifact_status"

count=0
for result in $RESULTS; do
  if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
    echo "gate: a required job finished as '$result'" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  count=$((count + 1))
done
if [ "$count" != "$EXPECTED_LEGS" ]; then
  echo "gate: $count results, expected $EXPECTED_LEGS" >&2
  exit 1
fi
